scripts.build: powershell -Command "if(Test-Path dist){Remove-Item dist -Recurse -Force}; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force dist; Copy-Item *.html,*.js,manifest.json,styles.css,resize.py -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue -Destination dist -Force; if(Test-Path assets){Copy-Item assets -Destination dist -Recurse -Force}; if(Test-Path images){Copy-Item images -Destination dist -Recurse -Force}"
